articles.title: What Should Qualcomm (QCOM) Investors Watch After 500 California Layoffs And New AI Moves?
articles.description: Qualcomm (NasdaqGS:QCOM) is cutting more than 500 jobs in California as it reshapes operations under pressure in its smartphone business. The company is reallocating resources toward new AI inference initiatives, backed by fresh technology partnerships announced in recent months. Qualcomm is also extending its reach into K-8 robotics education through programs built with Arduino, Disney Imagineering, and REV Robotics.
